finding.mechanism: The canonical UCF cycle carried runtime.generation while generation freshness was represented only by the same receipt's freshness.stale_generation boolean. The merged UCF boot-ancestry composition cross-bound source, Zero/GRF, bundled artifacts, J-Space/GWT and Claude capability but did not cross-bind cycle runtime generation to independent boot evidence.
finding.risk: A stale writer could present a structurally valid UCF cycle with a changed generation and self-report stale_generation=false; the bare UCF validator could not independently authenticate that freshness claim.
finding.counterhypothesis: Existing boot ancestry already independently authenticated runtime.generation.

delta.authority_path: existing tools/validate_ucf_boot_ancestry_chain_v1.py composition gate; no second UCF receipt authority created

unusual_experiment.reason: No immutable shared macrocycle/request identifier was exposed to this organ; no unusual-experiment lease was invented. The generation cases are deterministic fail-closed regressions/falsifiers only.

next_gate: Execute the composed canonical UCF + boot ancestry path on an actually-started exact-source admitted Ubuntu runtime whose boot evidence records the observed entity generation; retain unknown/stale generation as fail-closed rather than trusting self-report.
